<h1>Welcome</h1>

This mini documentation site introduces beginner-friendly tools and techniques for creating technical documentation.

The three guides on this site explain how to use GitHub and Visual Studio Code, how to write with Markdown, and how to build a website with Quarto.

## Getting Started with GitHub and VS Code

Learn how to set up Visual Studio Code and GitHub Desktop, create a repository, and save your work using commits and pushes.

[Read the GitHub and VS Code guide](github-vscode.qmd)

## Markdown Basics for Technical Documentation

Learn how to create headings, lists, links, code blocks, and images using Markdown.

[Read the Markdown guide](markdown-basics.qmd)

## Building and Previewing a Quarto Website

Learn how Quarto turns `.qmd` files into a working documentation website.

[Read the Quarto website guide](quarto-website.qmd)
